source_name: Architectural 6-Band Acoustic Materials Reference (ASTM C423 / ISO 354 / Biot-JCA Schema)
honest_disclaimer: Offline 32-profile architectural random-incidence absorption reference. Alfa Acoustics' commercial database is private and not scraped or redistributed here. Raw published Sabin absorption coefficients (including >1.0 edge-diffraction values) are stored separately from effective passive values (clamped to [0, 1]) used by the renderer's sqrt(1 - alpha_eff) reflection multiplier. Unmeasured Biot-JCA parameters (porosity, airflow resistivity, tortuosity, VCL, TCL) are explicitly marked null and never invented.

materials.name: Open Boundary (No Reflection)
materials.assembly: Idealized open free-field boundary (no physical reflecting wall)

biot.status: Not applicable — idealized open boundary.

materials.provenance: Analytical free-field zero-reflection boundary model
materials.notes: Zero reflection across all 6 octave bands; used for Open preset walls/ceiling and Direct preset.
uncertainties: Analytical boundary condition, not a physical lab-tested material.

materials.name: Wedge foam · 2 inches
materials.assembly: 2-inch (50.8 mm) open-cell polyurethane acoustic wedge foam, direct Type-A mount

biot.status: Not published in open architectural table — values not invented.

materials.provenance: Published ASTM C423 / architectural random-incidence reference (clamped <=1.0 for passive reflection)
materials.notes: SM7B reference baseline foam (published 1 kHz Sabin value 1.05 clamped to passive 1.0).
uncertainties: Raw 1000 Hz Sabin coefficient (1.05) exceeds 1.0 due to reverberation-room edge diffraction; renderer clamps effective absorption to 1.00.
Biot porous parameters (porosity, airflow resistivity, tortuosity, VCL, TCL) are not published here and not invented.
